calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as sales_net,
  SUM(f.standard_cost) as cost,
  COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 6
  AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

calls.statement:
WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) as sales_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.standard_cost), 0) as cost_goods
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 6
    AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY p.category
),
return_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as returns_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0) as returns_cost
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 6
    AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT 
  s.category,
  ROUND(s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0), 2) as net_sales,
  ROUND(((s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0) - (s.cost_goods - COALESCE(r.returns_cost, 0))) / (s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0))) * 100, 2) as gross_margin_pct
FROM sales_data s
LEFT JOIN return_data r ON s.category = r.category
ORDER BY s.category
